title: Superman vs Homelander: Power vs Restraint
script: This is Superman. This is Homelander. So what's the difference? Most people think Homelander is just a corrupted Superman. He's not. Superman gets his powers naturally from Earth's yellow sun and grew up taught to protect people no matter what. But Homelander's powers came from a lab-injected compound called Compound V, and he was raised as a weapon with no real love, only control. Superman constantly holds back his power. Homelander doesn't. Follow for more.
